item.title: Qatar and the US sign AI and critical minerals deals
item.description:
Qatar and the United States signed an AI acceleration partnership agreement and an MoU on securing supplies of critical minerals and rare earth elements on the sidelines of the Eighth Qatar-US Strategic Dialogue in Washington. Minister of State for Foreign Trade Dr Ahmed bin Mohammed Al Sayed and US Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick signed the agreement, which covers advanced semiconductors, digital infrastructure and reciprocal investment.
Sources: Qatar News Agency (QNA) https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/25/qatar-us-sign-agreement-and-mou-to-expand-cooperation-in-ai-critical-minerals · The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/25/11/2026/qatar-us-sign-agreement-and-mou-to-expand-cooperation-in-ai-critical-minerals · Al Raya https://www.raya.com/2026/11/24/قطر-والولايات-المتحدة-توقعان-اتفاقية-ومذكرة-تفاهم-لتعزيز-التعاون-في-مجالي-الذكاء-الاصطناعي-والمعادن-الحرجة

item.title: Prime Minister and US Vice President discuss de-escalation efforts
item.description:
Prime Minister and Minister of Foreign Affairs Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman bin Jassim Al-Thani met US Vice President JD Vance in Washington to discuss strategic cooperation and regional developments. The Prime Minister affirmed Qatar’s support for all diplomatic efforts towards a solution that ensures freedom of navigation and paves the way for a comprehensive agreement bringing lasting peace to the region.
Sources: Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/266199/latest-news/pm-us-vice-president-discuss-regional-developments · Al Sharq https://al-sharq.com/article/24/11/2026/رئيس-مجلس-الوزراء-يجتمع-مع-نائب-الرئيس-الأمريكي

item.title: Qatar and Canada hold first strategic dialogue, sign investment protection deal
item.description:
The Prime Minister and Minister of Foreign Affairs and Canadian Foreign Minister Anita Anand co-chaired the first Qatar-Canada Strategic Dialogue in Ottawa, and he met Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney on the sidelines. The two sides signed an investment promotion and protection agreement, an arrangement on Qatar protecting Canada’s interests in Afghanistan, and a letter of intent on the Qatar-Canada 2026 Year of Culture.
Sources: Al Sharq https://al-sharq.com/article/25/11/2026/رئيس-مجلس-الوزراء-وزير-الخارجية-ووزيرة-خارجية-كندا-يترأسان-الحوار-الاستراتيجي-الأول-بين-البلدين · Qatar News Agency (QNA) https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/24/prime-minister-and-minister-of-foreign-affairs-meets-canadas-prime-minister · Al Raya https://www.raya.com/2026/11/24/رئيس-الوزراء-تعزيز-الشراكة-الاستراتيجية-مع-كندا

item.title: Al Ansari: Qatar’s sovereignty decides its stance towards all parties
item.description:
Foreign Ministry spokesperson Dr Majed Al Ansari told the weekly briefing that Qatar will not accept any aggression against it in any form and that only diplomatic solutions can end the crisis. He said freedom of navigation and reopening the Strait of Hormuz are part of Qatar’s mediation, and that the summoning of Qatar’s chargé d’affaires in Tehran is being handled through diplomatic channels.
Sources: Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/266203/latest-news/qatars-sovereignty-is-deciding-factor-in-its-position-toward-all-parties-in-the-region-al-ansari · Gulf Times https://www.gulf-times.com/article/738955/qatar/qatar-escalation-will-undermine-mediation · The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/24/11/2026/qatars-sovereignty-determines-its-positions-toward-all-parties-in-the-region-foreign-ministry-spokesperson

item.title: Skeek Al Doha opens a walking trail linking five heritage sites
item.description:
Sheikha Al Mayassa bint Hamad bin Khalifa Al-Thani, Chairperson of Qatar Museums, opened Skeek Al Doha, a Qatar Tourism initiative in the capital’s historic heart. The dedicated walking route links five heritage landmarks, including Fereej Al Asmakh, Bayt Al Zaman, the Founder’s House and Doha Stadium, and runs for six months until mid-May.
Sources: Gulf Times https://www.gulf-times.com/article/738957/qatar/introducing-skeek-al-doha-to-revive-capitals-historic-heart · Al Raya https://www.raya.com/2026/11/24/الشيخة-المياسة-بنت-حمد-تفتتح-سكيك-الدوحة

item.title: Tunisia’s Hatem Mamlouk named Qatar basketball coach
item.description:
The Qatar Basketball Federation appointed Tunisian coach Hatem Mamlouk as head coach of the senior national team, succeeding compatriot Hakan Demir. Mamlouk will lead Al Annabi against South Korea on 26 November and Japan on 29 November at Al Janoub Hall in the Asian Qualifiers for the 2027 World Cup, which Doha hosts from 27 August to 12 September 2027.
Sources: Qatar News Agency (QNA) https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/25/tunisias-hatem-mamlouk-appointed-qatar-basketball-coach · Gulf Times https://www.gulf-times.com/article/738935/sport/qatar-sports/mamlouk-named-qatar-coach-ahead-of-south-korea-and-japan-clashes

item.title: Coalition: Houthis used a drone to attack Riyadh financial district tower
item.description:
Coalition spokesperson Maj. Gen. Turki Al Maliki said a drone was used in the attack on a tower at King Abdullah Financial District in Riyadh, vowing a resolute response to the targeting of civilians. Saudi Civil Defense said 11 people were injured, and the Arab League condemned the attack as a dangerous escalation and a flagrant breach of international law.
Sources: Qatar News Agency (QNA) https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/25/coalition-says-drone-used-in-attack-on-tower-at-riyadh-financial-center · Saudi Gazette https://www.saudigazette.com.sa/article/666506/saudi-arabia/coalition-houthi-terrorists-used-drone-to-attack-kafd-tower · Qatar News Agency (QNA) https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/25/arab-league-condemns-houthi-attack-on-riyadh-affirms-full-solidarity-with-saudi-arabia

item.title: Coalition strikes Hodeidah port after warning civilians to evacuate
item.description:
The Saudi-led coalition said early on Wednesday it struck “operational capabilities” at Hodeidah port and destroyed targets in Saada and Amran, after asking civilians on Tuesday evening to evacuate the port. Houthi military spokesman Yahya Saree had threatened to target Jeddah port and other Saudi Red Sea ports if Hodeidah was hit, and the group counted 72 air strikes on Sanaa and seven provinces in 24 hours.
Sources: Al Jazeera English https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/11/25/iran-war-live-houthis-threaten-saudi-ports-over-coalitions-hodeidah-order · Sada El Balad https://www.elbalad.news/7193646 · Sada El Balad https://www.elbalad.news/7193623

item.title: Riyadh and Washington stress freedom of navigation in Hormuz and Bab al-Mandab
item.description:
Saudi Foreign Minister Prince Faisal bin Farhan held a phone call with US Secretary of State Marco Rubio in which both condemned Houthi attacks on civilians and energy facilities in the Kingdom and stressed freedom of navigation through the Strait of Hormuz and Bab al-Mandab. They also discussed efforts to consolidate security in Sudan and Lebanon, according to the Saudi Press Agency and the State Department.
Sources: Masrawy (SPA) https://www.masrawy.com/news/news_publicaffairs/details/2026/11/25/3084121/x · Ahwal (SPA) https://ahwal.sa/archives/288313 · Al Mashhad https://www.almashhad.news/news/509499

item.title: Brent rebounds 2.27% to $91.40 after attacks near Hormuz
item.description:
Brent futures settled up $2.03, or 2.27%, at $91.40 a barrel on Tuesday after falling during the session to their lowest since August. US crude rose 2.35% to $82.05 following reports that a container ship was targeted near the Strait of Hormuz and three vessels were struck by unidentified projectiles, while expectations of surplus supply capped gains.
Sources: The Nation Thailand https://nationthailand.com/news/world/40073886 · Rallies.ai (Reuters) https://rallies.ai/news/oil-settles-up-2-as-traders-weigh-continued-hormuz-ship-attacks-49ed49d098482c83

item.title: Kuwait approves the unified GCC excise tax agreement by decree-law
item.description:
Kuwait issued Decree-Law No. 140 of 2026 approving the Unified GCC Excise Tax Agreement and its amendment annex signed on 1 June 2025, effective from publication in the official gazette. Kuwait is the last GCC state to advance the tax, which could cover tobacco, energy drinks and sweetened beverages.
Sources: Al Anba (KUNA) https://www.alanba.com.kw/1386457 · Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/world/gulf/kuwait/kuwait-approves-gcc-excise-tax-agreement-what-could-be-taxed-1.500759724

item.title: Abdelatty and Safadi call for unhindered aid into Gaza
item.description:
Foreign Minister Dr Badr Abdelatty received his Jordanian counterpart Ayman Safadi in Cairo, and the two stressed stabilising the Gaza Strip and implementing all provisions of the US President’s peace plan. They called for sufficient and sustained humanitarian aid to enter the Strip without obstruction and for preserving the unity of Palestinian territory in Gaza and the West Bank.
Sources: Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/24/x/7631516 · Al Sharq (QNA) https://al-sharq.com/article/25/11/2026/مصر-والأردن-يؤكدان-ضرورة-ضمان-إدخال-المساعدات-الإنسانية-المستدامة-إلى-قطاع-غزة-دون-عوائق

item.title: Sami Komsan nears Al Ahly job after Amouta’s dismissal
item.description:
Sami Komsan, coach of Arab Contractors, is close to taking charge of Al Ahly on an interim basis, replacing Morocco’s Hussein Amouta, who was sacked after a 2-0 defeat to Pyramids. Arab Contractors chairman Mohsen Salah said he formally approved Komsan’s move, as Al Ahly prepare to face Angola’s Primeiro de Agosto on Sunday in the CAF Confederation Cup group stage.
Sources: Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/24/x/7631527 · Sada El Balad https://www.elbalad.news/7193629

item.title: 21-carat gold trades between EGP5,555 and EGP5,600 as global gold weakens
item.description:
A gram of 21-carat gold traded between EGP5,555 and EGP5,600 on Wednesday morning, depending on the source, after losing about EGP115 on Tuesday. 24-carat gold stood between EGP6,349 and EGP6,400, and the gold pound fell below EGP45,000, as the ounce traded below $3,600 globally.
Sources: Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/25/x/7631260 · Sada El Balad https://www.elbalad.news/7193526

item.title: Dollar steady at EGP54.27 for sale at major banks
item.description:
The dollar was steady early on Wednesday at EGP54.17 to buy and EGP54.27 to sell at National Bank of Egypt and Banque Misr, and at EGP54.30 to sell at the central bank. Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank posted the highest rate at EGP54.41 to sell, after the dollar neared EGP55 earlier in the week.
Sources: Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/25/x/7631162 · Sada El Balad https://www.elbalad.news/7193537

item.title: Met authority forecasts light rain in the north and morning fog
item.description:
The Egyptian Meteorological Authority forecast chances of light rain on Wednesday over the northwest coast, the northern Delta, North Sinai and Halayeb and Shalateen, possibly reaching Greater Cairo at times. It warned of fog, dense at times, from 4am to 9am on roads to the north, the Canal cities and northern Upper Egypt, with active winds.
Sources: Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/news/news_egypt/details/2026/11/25/3084104/x · Sada El Balad https://www.elbalad.news/7193084

item.title: Trump says the Iran war is funded until January
item.description:
US President Donald Trump told the New York Post that military operations against Iran are funded until January and that his administration faces no immediate funding crisis. He voiced concern that his military options could be constrained when Democrats take control of both chambers of Congress on 3 January, warning that ending the war early could turn victory into loss.
Sources: Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/news/news_publicaffairs/details/2026/11/25/3084126/x · Sada El Balad https://www.elbalad.news/7193638

item.title: Putin says retaliation for strikes on Russian refineries is inevitable
item.description:
Russian President Vladimir Putin told government officials and senior oil executives at the Kremlin that retaliation for Ukrainian attacks on Russian refineries is “inevitable”. He accused Kyiv of ignoring the US President’s request to refrain from such strikes, after Ukraine said it would halt them only when Moscow stops hitting Ukrainian energy facilities.
Sources: Al Jazeera English https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/24/putin-says-kyiv-hit-russian-oil-plants-despite-trump-plea-vows-retaliation · Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/25/x/7631483

item.title: KOSPI falls about 5% and Nikkei 2.5% in a chip stock sell-off
item.description:
Asian shares fell on Wednesday morning after Wall Street’s losses, with South Korea’s KOSPI down 4.78% at 4,766.79 and Japan’s Nikkei 225 down 2.52% at 57,167.55. Semiconductor and memory stocks led the decline, with Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix down more than 6%, erasing the KOSPI’s gains from Tuesday’s session.
Sources: TradingKey https://www.tradingkey.com/analysis/stocks/more/262320970-japan-south-korea-stocks-kospi-nikkei-softbank-sk-hynix-samsung-kioxia-tradingkey · JBizNews https://jbiznews.com/kospi-sinks-more-than-4-nikkei-slides-more-than-2-in-early-wednesday-trading-after-wall-streets-tuesday-retreat/

item.title: Gold slips to $3,544 as US rate hike expectations build
item.description:
Spot gold fell 0.3% to $3,544.54 an ounce by 12:24am GMT on Wednesday after dropping more than 2% in the previous session. Hawkish signals from the Federal Reserve reinforced expectations of a December rate hike, as investors awaited US inflation data.
Sources: Masrawy (Reuters) https://www.masrawy.com/news/news_economy/details/2026/11/25/3084124/x · Sada El Balad https://www.elbalad.news/7193526

item.title: UN: 47,000 women were killed by partners or relatives in 2025
item.description:
A report by UN Women and the UN Office on Drugs and Crime found that more than 47,000 women and girls, about five every hour, were intentionally killed by a partner or family member in 2025. Released on Tuesday for the International Day for the Elimination of Violence against Women, the figure remains close to previous years’ levels.
Sources: Al Jazeera English https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/24/five-women-killed-every-hour-globally-by-partner-relative-in-2025-un · Oman Observer (AFP) https://www.omanobserver.om/article/1200161/world/asia/five-women-killed-each-hour-by-relatives-in-2025-un

item.title: Four countries in the Americas to host the 2031 Women’s World Cup
item.description:
An extraordinary FIFA Congress named the United States, Mexico, Costa Rica and Jamaica as hosts of the 2031 Women’s World Cup, the first with 48 teams. England, Northern Ireland, Scotland and Wales were awarded the 2035 edition, and US President Donald Trump said his country has what it takes to host the tournament.
Sources: The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/24/11/2026/us-mexico-costa-rica-and-jamaica-to-host-fifa-womens-world-cup-2031 · Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/25/x/7631483
